citation.title: Effect of Titrating Positive End-Expiratory Pressure (PEEP) With an Esophageal Pressure–Guided Strategy vs an Empirical High PEEP-FIO2 Strategy on Death and Days Free From Mechanical Ventilation Among Patients With Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome: A Randomized Clinical Trial

provenance.quote: Patients aged 16 years or older with moderate to severe ARDS (PaO2:FIO2 ≤200 mm Hg) onset within the last 36 hours were eligible for enrollment.
Two hundred mechanically ventilated patients aged 16 years and older with moderate to severe ARDS (PaO2:FIO2 ≤200 mm Hg) were enrolled.
The trial enrolled participants at 14 hospitals across the United States and Canada.

PEEP was evaluated at least once daily and adjusted as needed to maintain end-expiratory PL between 0 to 6 cm H2O, ensuring PEEP was never less than nor substantially more than pleural pressure estimated by PES.

Prespecified secondary clinical end points included all-cause mortality at 28 days, 60 days, and 1 year; ventilator-free days through day 28; intensive care unit (ICU) and hospital lengths of stay through day 28 and day 60; protocol failure requiring rescue therapy; and functional status at 1 year.
Two hundred patients were enrolled (mean [SD] age, 56 [16] years; 46% female) and completed 28-day follow-up.
Phase 2 randomized clinical trial conducted at 14 hospitals in North America.
JAMA. Published online February 18, 2019.

provenance.quote: Probability of more favorable outcome ... 49.6 (41.7 to 57.5)

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS: all enrolled had moderate to severe ARDS per inclusion criteria. Obesity: BMI not reported; unclear. Timing: median time from intubation to enrollment was 22h, and intervention started at enrollment; thus within 48h of intubation. PTP target: used absolute PES subtraction targeting end-expiratory PL 0-6 cmH2O.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Confirmed via COHORTS.md: sarge_2021 states it is a post hoc reanalysis of EPVent-2 including all 200 participants.

blinding: not reported in the paper.
balloon_calibration: method not reported in main text; supplement not reviewed.
n_enrolled: abstract says 200 enrolled, but CONSORT shows 202 randomized, 2 withdrew consent. Set n_enrolled=202.
